payload.friendly_name: Bound reconciliation windows at the Mission base (#7560)
payload.purpose_context: On a fork, the target branch often does not contain the commit a Mission was cut from. Consolidation then reads pre-Mission history as Mission-authored and refuses the landing (DEPENDENCY_REF_COVERS_MISSION_WORK, or phantom un-attributable deletions), with no workaround. This Mission records the Mission's base commit and bounds every reconciliation window at it, without weakening refusals for genuine Mission work.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let an integration Mission on a fork consolidate: history from before the Mission was created is never treated as Mission work.

payload.question: Where does the reconciliation windows' lower bound (the Mission base) come from?

payload.final_answer: Record + derive: new meta.json mission_base_sha recorded at create/mint; existing Missions derive it (see specify.design.base-derivation); else fall back fail-closed to today's target bound; report recorded vs derived.

payload.question: For Missions without a recorded mission_base_sha, how is the base derived? (Corrects an earlier lane-base recommendation found unsound by the challenger.)

payload.final_answer: Scaffold parent: first parent of the earliest first-parent commit on the Mission branch that adds kitty-specs/<slug>/; not derivable -> today's target bound (fail-closed).

payload.question: Apply the Mission-base exclusion to the guard only, or to every window axis?

payload.final_answer: All window axes, with an ADR 2026-09-29-1 amendment in this Mission. The declared-ref window itself stays target..ref (challenger finding).
Fold #7593 (consolidation reads commit-to-target stamps only through consolidation_events); blocked until PR #7596 merges.
